tools.name: inspect_spec
tools.description: Build real CadQuery solids and measure validity, dimensions, tray walls and clearance.

tools.name: generate_rover
tools.description: Generate/export a bounded rover, evaluate and repair failed constraints. Writes only .runs/mcp/<job_id>.

content.text:

      "name": "Solid validity",

    {
      "name": "Chassis thickness",

    {
      "name": "Tray wall",
      "measured": 1.2,
      "requirement": "≥ 2.4 mm",

      "unit": "mm",

    },
    {
      "name": "Board clearance",
      "measured": 0.1,
      "requirement": "≥ 0.8 mm",
      "passed": false,
      "unit": "mm",

    {
      "name": "Chassis length",

    },
    {
      "name": "Tray edge margin",

      "unit": "mm",

    }
  ]
